chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، عَنِ الصَّفَّارِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ الْوَشَّاءِ، عَنۡ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذَ، عَنۡ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ، عَنۡ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ قَالَ

translations.en: From Ibn al-Walid, from al-Saffar, from Ibn Isa, from al-Washsha, from Ahmad b. Aidh, from Abi Khadija, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: النَّاسُ يَغْدُونَ عَلَىٰ ثَلَاثَةٍ (ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ)

translations.en: The people rise up (every morning) being in one of three categories: (then he mentioned its like)

en.summary: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) states that people are categorized into three types when they rise for their daily activities. The text indicates that the specific categories were mentioned subsequently in the full narration.
en.seo_question: What are the three categories of people mentioned in this hadith from al-Khisal?
